custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use three parts, part A, part B and part C, that were at the test location before this release was installed and that nobody has changed since.
  • Use a part B that has stock on hand and a saved Min and Max, so its tracking can be seen in its window.
  • Have an inactive part, part D, at the test location, so the Inactive tab has a part it must list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Find parts from before this release: On the Inventory list, parts that came with this site's data and were never changed have no clock icon at the left of their row; for example 3030 Long Stroke Brake Chamber (W3030LS), which has stock and Min 10 and Max 50, and 3030 Standard Brake Chamber, 13.25" Rod (W3030T). Use those two and a third part with no clock icon, for example W4515Q.
  2. Use W3030LS as part B.
  3. Make part D: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C154753 PART D; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154753-D; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00. Click Save.
  4. Set part D inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C154753-D. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
